data.long_meaning: The name Shara is derived from the Hebrew word shor, meaning mountain or hill. In the Bible, Shara appears as the name of a Hittite princess who married Pharaoh Shishak. The name Shara carries the meaning “Mountainous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shara usually hope their child will grow to embody mountainous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
